concepts/agent.title: Agent
concepts/agent.description: A participant that forms its own significance on a kline — a subjective grading. Three roles determine rationalising strategies: Trainee, Trainer, Supervisor.

concepts/canon.title: Canon
concepts/canon.description: A kline structure where signature = signature_of(nodes), claiming S1 — the signature stands for its nodes and carries no information beyond them.

concepts/canonical-synthesis.title: Canonical synthesis
concepts/canonical-synthesis.description: The S2 proposal at step 16 in similar_fit that represents the correct recombination for mhall — the benchmark proposal expand fails to emit.

concepts/cogitation.title: Cogitation
concepts/cogitation.description: The slow path of rationalisation — model traversal that tests a kline's structural claim against what Kalvin holds, draining a backlog of S2/S3 klines and emitting proposals.

concepts/convergence.title: Convergence
concepts/convergence.description: The state where the trainee's rational significance for a kline matches the curriculum's target significance — the gap that training closes.

concepts/curriculum.title: Curriculum
concepts/curriculum.description: A living structured document owned by the Harness — the source of truth for training, never rolled back. Three sections: objective, approach, lessons.

concepts/distributed-rationality.title: Distributed Rationality
concepts/distributed-rationality.description: The aspiration of networks of Kalvin instances mutually ratifying each other's understanding — honest measurement of what each knows, at scale.

concepts/engine-first.title: Engine first
concepts/engine-first.description: Process discipline — suspect the engine before retreating to .ks authoring. The engine is the target; the curriculum is the lever.

concepts/escalation.title: Escalation
concepts/escalation.description: The rationalising trainer deferring a proposal to the supervisor when its cogitation yields no reply. The boundary between what the Trainer resolves and what the supervisor resolves.

concepts/expectation.title: Expectation
concepts/expectation.description: A scripted kline that enters the slow path (S2/S3) during rationalisation and requires a matching proposal to be satisfied.

concepts/fast-route-vs-slow-route.title: Fast route vs slow route
concepts/fast-route-vs-slow-route.description: Engine routing paths — fast admits identities and seen-signature canons; slow unpacks unseen-signature canons as asks and discovers signatures. Dispatch is on sig_level, not the compiled stamp.

concepts/fit.title: Fit
concepts/fit.description: How closely a new kline's nodes resolve (or fail to resolve) to grounded identities and relationships — the structural basis from which significance emerges.

concepts/frame.title: Frame
concepts/frame.description: Kalvin's focus of attention and how it is shifting — the active cogitation kline, plus what focused attention produces. Monotonic, signature-keyed, multi-valued.

concepts/grounding.title: Grounding
concepts/grounding.description: The model's mechanism for realising significance — at any level. A grounded signature guarantees its nodes are grounded; Frame-grounded klines are available for cogitation; LTM-grounded klines are frame promotions Kalvin deems important enough to remember.

concepts/harness.title: Harness
concepts/harness.description: The multi-agent runtime that loads agents as participants and runs a dialogue loop between them — a message broker routing role-addressed messages.

concepts/identity.title: Identity
concepts/identity.description: A terminal kline structure that is directly decodable — a known value (`{S: [S]}`) that claims S1, 'I know this.'

concepts/kline.title: KLine
concepts/kline.description: The fundamental unit of Kalvin's memory — a structure containing a signature (head) and a nodes list, between which holds a relationship Kalvin rationalises as Structural Significance.

concepts/kvalue.title: KValue
concepts/kvalue.description: The unit of exchange between participants — a KLine paired with a significance (the sender's assessment of it).

concepts/learned-preferences.title: Learned Preferences
concepts/learned-preferences.description: The paths through the model Kalvin favours when multiple candidates compete — learned, not fixed; there is no utility function. What Kalvin values is itself teachable.

concepts/misfit.title: Misfit
concepts/misfit.description: A kline structure where the signature does not equal signature_of(nodes); sub-shapes include no-fit (S2), underfit (S2), overfit (S2), and connote/denote (S3).

concepts/monotonic-growth.title: Monotonic Growth
concepts/monotonic-growth.description: The property that Kalvin's knowledge base only grows, never shrinks. Correction occurs by outcompeting, not deletion.

concepts/mts-multi-token-signature.title: MTS (Multi-Token Signature)
concepts/mts-multi-token-signature.description: A KScript compiler device that expands a multi-character signature identifier into its constituent character identities plus one MTS relationship.

concepts/node.title: Node
concepts/node.description: A structural slot in a kline's nodes list — either a Token Id or the signature of another kline.

concepts/non-judging-harness.title: Non-judging harness
concepts/non-judging-harness.description: Harness principle — it compiles, feeds, retrieves, and presents with no verdict and no band-matching. Judgement belongs to the trainer (a pi agent outside the loop).

concepts/per-turn-scoping.title: Per-turn scoping
concepts/per-turn-scoping.description: observations and _incoming reset to fresh lists at the top of every rationalise() call — each turn's emissions are independent of prior turns'.

concepts/priming.title: Priming
concepts/priming.description: Presenting a kline to Kalvin to shape the context for what follows — preparing the model's state so subsequent rationalisation lands differently.

concepts/proposal.title: Proposal
concepts/proposal.description: A KLine emitted by an agent during rationalisation — offered for ratification by the other agent.

concepts/querying.title: Querying
concepts/querying.description: Kalvin issuing an S4 (Unknown) kline to ask another agent for an identity ratification — the structural form of a question.

concepts/ratify.title: Ratify
concepts/ratify.description: The action of countersigning a selected proposal; usually performed by the Trainer during curriculum execution. Ratification promotes a proposal to S1 and records provenance.

concepts/rational-significance.title: Rational Significance
concepts/rational-significance.description: A participant's measurement of whether a kline's structural claim holds against what Kalvin holds — refined through model traversal and learned preferences, classified S1–S4.

concepts/relational-tokens.title: Relational Tokens
concepts/relational-tokens.description: The closed set of KScript tokens (==, =>, >, =, none) declaring how a kline is produced and its provenance — COUNTERSIGNS, CANONICALISES, CONNOTES, DENOTES, UNKNOWN.

concepts/relationship.title: Relationship
concepts/relationship.description: The single-node misfit — a non-terminal whose signature associates with exactly one other value (`{A: [B]}`, A != B), named as a distinct routing class.

concepts/s2-expansion.title: S2 Expansion
concepts/s2-expansion.description: How the engine reshapes an S2 misfit into proposals — Kalvin does not invent, it reshapes what is already there and offers the result. The agent decides what to keep.

concepts/scaffolding.title: Scaffolding
concepts/scaffolding.description: KScript entries that provide grounding context for other entries — structurally identical whether pre-compiled or reactive.

concepts/signature.title: Signature
concepts/signature.description: The value occupying a kline's head position — the head value a kline's nodes compose against, and a value other klines hold as nodes.

concepts/signature-discovery.title: Signature discovery
concepts/signature-discovery.description: The rule that signatures are only discovered when the slow route unpacks them from S2/S3 incomings — feeding an S1 identity alone doesn't ground it until K frames the signature first.

concepts/significance.title: Significance
concepts/significance.description: A measurement of how well-grounded a response is, emerging directly from how a new kline fits the model — not a score applied after the fact.

concepts/significance-spectrum-s1s4.title: Significance Spectrum (S1–S4)
concepts/significance-spectrum-s1s4.description: The four significance levels — S1 recognised, S2 contested, S3 suggested, S4 unrecognised — that every kline claim and every rationalisation is measured against.

concepts/silent-synthesis.title: Silent synthesis
concepts/silent-synthesis.description: expand's behaviour where the WDMH↔MHALL pair grades S1/S3 and nothing is proposed — an open question whether this is correct or a regression.

concepts/structural-significance.title: Structural Significance
concepts/structural-significance.description: The significance a kline's structure claims on its own — an S-level derived from the signature–nodes relationship alone, without model traversal. The ground truth every participant measures against.

concepts/study.title: Study
concepts/study.description: Rationalisation continuing during quiet periods — revisiting partial knowledge to strengthen understanding. Cannot reach S1 without agent ratification.

concepts/supervisor.title: Supervisor
concepts/supervisor.description: An agent that resolves proposals the Trainer escalates — deciding ratify, scaffold, or continue. Medium-independent: TUI, Slack, CLI, or LLMSupervisor.

concepts/target-significance.title: Target Significance
concepts/target-significance.description: The significance a compiled kline is labelled with — the answer the script asserts the trainee should learn to derive. A compiler/provenance concern, never a participant's lived significance.

concepts/terminal.title: Terminal
concepts/terminal.description: A kline whose structure carries no further decomposition — a leaf that tells Kalvin to stop traversing. Three shapes: empty nodes, self-referential nodes, and the compound-word form.

concepts/trainee.title: Trainee
concepts/trainee.description: The participant under instruction — the rationalising system being trained, and the subject of a training session. Bus role `trainee`.

concepts/trainer.title: Trainer
concepts/trainer.description: A rationaliser — the trainer-side peer of the trainee, sharing the same engine but keeping S1 ratifications and S2 proposals. Cogitates and escalates.

concepts/unknown.title: Unknown
concepts/unknown.description: A terminal kline structure with empty nodes (`{S: []}`) that claims S4 — the structural form of an ask, requesting an Identity ratification.

concepts/word-binding.title: Word Binding
concepts/word-binding.description: The association of a single-character KScript signature with a word, resolved through annotations — fill-if-empty at top level, unconditional override inline.

entities/auto-tune.title: Auto-Tune
entities/auto-tune.description: The project's experimental loop for tuning Kalvin's rationalisation behaviour — an LLM coding agent runs repeated sessions, observes the reactor/cogitator/rationaliser, edits the significance-model code, and re-runs.

entities/cogitate.title: cogitate()
entities/cogitate.description: The engine function implementing cogitation — one full LIFO pass over the work-list, emitting semantic predicates (ask S4 / countersign S3 / propose S2 / ground S1).

entities/contextmd.title: CONTEXT.md
entities/contextmd.description: The project's domain glossary — the source of truth for terminology. Source is the truth document; CONTEXT.md's glossary maps the terms the source uses.

entities/expand.title: expand
entities/expand.description: A cogitation strategy for the S2 arm — grades grounded candidates via kalvin.expand.expand. The dialogue harness default. Emits few proposals; exhibits silent synthesis on mhall.

entities/harness.title: Harness (implementation)
entities/harness.description: The training harness runtime — the multi-agent WebSocket server and message bus, plus the synchronous dialogue harness. Both drive the K engine.

entities/isgroundable.title: _is_groundable()
entities/isgroundable.description: The engine predicate that decides whether a kline can be grounded, branching in order: identity → signature grounded; canon → all nodes grounded; relationship → reciprocal grounded; misfit → both.

entities/k-engine.title: K (engine)
entities/k-engine.description: The cognitive/reasoning engine — the stateless core that derives one dialogue turn from (state, incoming) and returns (batch, observations). The implementation of Kalvin's rationalisation.

entities/kalvin.title: Kalvin
entities/kalvin.description: The rationalising system — an agent whose every response carries significance, a measurement of how well-grounded the response is in what it already knows.

entities/kdbg.title: KDbg
entities/kdbg.description: Debug annotation carried on each compiled kline — holds the owning scope's annotation (parens stripped) and a scope level (0 for source, 1 for MTS).

entities/kscript.title: KScript
entities/kscript.description: The DSL that authors training material by declaring klines and labelling them with Target Significance. A compiler/provenance concern — it produces structures and target labels, never a participant's lived significance.

entities/ltm-long-term-memory.title: LTM (Long-Term Memory)
entities/ltm-long-term-memory.description: What Kalvin holds as grounded knowledge — the commitment relation to held klines. Structurally identical to Frame; the distinction is what is counted on vs what is in focus.

entities/marys-world.title: Mary's World
entities/marys-world.description: A reference teaching example used throughout the vision — building knowledge from a blank slate, one kline at a time, scaffolding where understanding is incomplete.

entities/mhall.title: mhall
entities/mhall.description: Test case ('Mary had a little lamb') on which both cogitation strategies reach the same grounded model but diverge on S2 emissions.

entities/promote.title: _promote()
entities/promote.description: The engine cascade that grounds groundable entries to fixed point at S1. Does not emit S2 proposals — promotion is the fast S1 path.

entities/rationalise.title: rationalise()
entities/rationalise.description: The engine function driving one full rationalisation turn — resets observations and _incoming, runs route → cogitate → _promote, and emits the turn's batch.

entities/route.title: route()
entities/route.description: The engine function that dispatches an incoming kline on its structural significance (sig_level), not on the producer's compiled stamp. The entry to fast/slow routing.

entities/similarfit.title: similar_fit
entities/similarfit.description: A cogitation strategy for the S2 arm — the graft heuristic. Emits many proposals (12 on mhall), including the canonical synthesis at step 16.

entities/stm-short-term-memory.title: STM (Short-Term Memory)
entities/stm-short-term-memory.description: Recent attention — what Kalvin was just thinking about. Written by attention itself; the temporally-situated relation to held klines. Empty at session start.

entities/tokenencoder.title: TokenEncoder
entities/tokenencoder.description: The KScript compiler stage that resolves word bindings and produces encoded KLines from symbolic entries. Where identities receive their node labels.

entities/wdmh.title: WDMH
entities/wdmh.description: Signature for 'we don't know Mary, had a little lamb' — the other half of the WDMH↔MHALL pair at the centre of the silent-synthesis open question.
